verdict.rationale: Official docs show a substantial developer platform: a quickstart to build an agent in Teams, guidance for porting Slack Bolt apps, the Microsoft Graph Teams API for automating teams, channels and messages, and the Agents Toolkit CLI with templates, samples, provisioning and publishing. However, no evidence item names or describes an official language SDK or client library. The story is therefore only inferred from APIs, tooling and the porting guide, and one community report says integration requires the full Azure/Graph stack. Missing for 10: explicitly documented official SDKs (named packages, supported languages, reference docs), independent hands-on corroboration of building with them.
